INSERT INTO `services` (`slug`, `name`, `brand`, `category`, `description`, `basePrice`, `priceUnit`, `pricingTiers`, `phase`, `sortOrder`) VALUES
('inbound-logistics', 'Inbound Logistics', 'stagegate', 'logistics', 'Airport pickup, customs coordination, climate-controlled receiving, and full arrival inspection. We take custody the moment your robot lands at Harry Reid International Airport.', 350.00, 'per robot', '[{"label":"Standard","price":350,"unit":"per robot"},{"label":"Concierge","price":1200,"unit":"per robot"}]', 'phase1', 1),
('warehousing-storage', 'Warehousing & Storage', 'stagegate', 'logistics', 'Secure, climate-controlled storage of robots and equipment pre-show, post-show, or year-round. No more shipping robots back and forth between shows — they live with us.', 150.00, 'per week', '[{"label":"Weekly","price":150,"unit":"per week"},{"label":"Annual","price":3600,"unit":"per year"}]', 'phase1', 2),
('staging-activation', 'Staging & Activation', 'stagegate', 'activation', 'Unpack, bench test, firmware update, charge, booth delivery, assembly, and full calibration. Your robot arrives on the show floor ready to perform — every time.', 800.00, 'per show', '[{"label":"Standard","price":800,"unit":"per show"},{"label":"Full-Service","price":3000,"unit":"per show"}]', 'phase1', 3),
('live-technical-support', 'Live Technical Support', 'stagegate', 'support', 'On-call robotics technician on the show floor. Rapid repair, daily startup and shutdown cycles, and real-time troubleshooting during live demos and presentations.', 450.00, 'per half-day', '[{"label":"Half-Day","price":450,"unit":"per half-day"},{"label":"3-Day Package","price":2500,"unit":"per 3 days"}]', 'phase1', 4),
('stagehand-247', 'StageHand 24/7', 'stagehand', 'support', 'Remote and on-site technical support for robots in the wild — post-sales, ongoing deployments, and emergency repair. Monthly retainers and SLA contracts available.', 1200.00, 'per month', '[{"label":"Standard Retainer","price":1200,"unit":"per month"},{"label":"Enterprise SLA","price":2500,"unit":"per month"}]', 'phase2', 5),
('stagepro-training', 'StagePro Training', 'stagepro', 'training', 'Hands-on robot technician training. Students learn by shadowing master technicians repairing real client robots — every brand, every type. 1-day workshops to 6-week certification programs.', 495.00, 'per student', '[{"label":"1-Day Workshop","price":495,"unit":"per student"},{"label":"3-Day Certification","price":1200,"unit":"per student"},{"label":"6-Week Apprentice","price":4500,"unit":"per student"},{"label":"Corporate Cohort","price":12000,"unit":"per cohort"}]', 'phase2', 6),
('showroom-demo', 'Showroom & Demo', 'stagegate', 'showroom', 'Permanent display space for year-round demos, investor visits, and off-floor activations. Showcase your robot to buyers, partners, and media without the cost of a full trade show booth.', 1500.00, 'per month', '[{"label":"Monthly","price":1500,"unit":"per month"},{"label":"Annual","price":15000,"unit":"per year"}]', 'phase2', 7),
('robot-sales-marketing', 'Robot Sales & Marketing', 'stagegate', 'marketing', 'Distribution partnerships, brand activations via The Robot Guild, and StageGate Ready™ certification. We help you build your brand presence and sell robots in the US market.', NULL, '10–20% commission', '[{"label":"Distribution Commission","price":null,"unit":"10–20% of facilitated sales"},{"label":"Brand Activation","price":15000,"unit":"per event"},{"label":"StageGate Ready™ Cert","price":2500,"unit":"per robot"}]', 'phase2', 8);

('Phoenix Logistics', 'customs', 'Sarah Chen', 'sarah@phoenixlogistics.com', '+1-702-555-0101', 'https://phoenixlogistics.com', 'Las Vegas', 'Specializes in trade show freight and ATA Carnet processing. 24/7 availability during major shows.'),
('TCB 3PL Las Vegas', 'transporter', 'Mike Torres', 'mike@tcb3pl.com', '+1-702-555-0102', 'https://tcb3pl.com', 'Las Vegas', 'White-glove transport from Harry Reid Airport to LVCC and warehouse. Preferred partner for sensitive equipment.'),
